output.summary: A succulent shrub or small tree of unspecified native origin, it is widespread in eastern South Africa and Eswatini and also abundant in the drier southern Cape. It commonly has reddish stems and green leaves. In Southern Africa it is commonly eaten, usually in salad or soup, but should not be confused with the mildly toxic jade plant.
